Thông tin về thành phần, khối lượng, giá trị dinh dưỡng, chất gây dị ứng, hướng dẫn sử dụng, hướng dẫn bảo quản, hạn sử dụng và cảnh báo liên quan có thể thay đổi theo từng sản phẩm hoặc phiên bản. Quý khách cần đọc kỹ thông tin trên bao bì của sản phẩm thực tế trước khi sử dụng. Trường hợp có khác biệt, thông tin trên bao bì sản phẩm tại thời điểm mua sẽ được ưu tiên áp dụng, trừ khi pháp luật có quy định khác.

paragraphs: Việc gửi biểu mẫu liên hệ, yêu cầu báo giá, đề nghị phân phối, yêu cầu hỗ trợ hoặc thông tin khác qua Website không mặc nhiên làm phát sinh hợp đồng mua bán, quan hệ đại lý, quan hệ phân phối hoặc bất kỳ cam kết thương mại nào với Tai Ky Food.

Giao dịch chỉ được xác lập khi các bên hoàn tất quy trình áp dụng và có xác nhận đơn hàng, hợp đồng hoặc văn bản thỏa thuận phù hợp. Giá bán, chương trình khuyến mại, phạm vi giao hàng và tình trạng hàng hóa có thể khác nhau theo kênh bán, địa bàn, thời điểm và đối tác phân phối.

sections.title: Mục đích xử lý dữ liệu

sections.title: Căn cứ xử lý dữ liệu cá nhân
paragraphs: Tùy theo bối cảnh, Tai Ky Food xử lý dữ liệu trên một hoặc nhiều căn cứ được pháp luật cho phép, bao gồm sự đồng ý của chủ thể dữ liệu; việc giao kết hoặc thực hiện hợp đồng; việc thực hiện nghĩa vụ pháp lý; xử lý trong trường hợp pháp luật cho phép không cần sự đồng ý; và các căn cứ hợp pháp khác.

Khi xử lý dựa trên sự đồng ý, Quý khách có quyền rút lại sự đồng ý theo quy định pháp luật. Tai Ky Food sẽ cung cấp thông tin cần thiết và xin sự đồng ý riêng trong những trường hợp pháp luật yêu cầu, đặc biệt đối với dữ liệu cá nhân nhạy cảm hoặc mục đích mới khác đáng kể so với mục đích đã thông báo.

sections.title: Chuyển dữ liệu cá nhân ra nước ngoài

Khi phát sinh chuyển dữ liệu cá nhân ra nước ngoài, Công ty sẽ thực hiện các yêu cầu, điều kiện, hồ sơ và biện pháp bảo vệ theo pháp luật Việt Nam hiện hành.
Tai Ky Food áp dụng biện pháp hợp lý để dữ liệu tiếp tục được bảo vệ trong quá trình truyền, lưu trữ và xử lý tại nước ngoài.

Các biện pháp có thể bao gồm phân quyền truy cập, quản lý tài khoản, lưu trữ an toàn, sao lưu, ghi nhận hoạt động hệ thống, mã hóa khi phù hợp, yêu cầu bảo mật đối với nhân sự và nhà cung cấp, cùng quy trình ứng phó sự cố.

privacy_en.title: PRIVACY POLICY
intro: TAIKY FOOD - FLOUR JOINT STOCK COMPANY (“Tai Ky Food”, “the Company”, “we”, “our” or “us”) respects privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data of consumers, customers, business partners, suppliers, candidates, Website visitors and other individuals who interact with us.

This Privacy Policy explains how Tai Ky Food collects, uses, retains, discloses, protects and otherwise processes personal data when you visit our Website; contact us; enquire about or use our products; participate in programmes or events; apply for a position; or otherwise interact with our business.

Tai Ky Food processes personal data in accordance with applicable Vietnamese law, including Law on Personal Data Protection No. 91/2025/QH15, Decree No. 356/2025/ND-CP detailing and guiding implementation of that Law, and relevant rules on cybersecurity, cyber-information security, electronic transactions and consumer protection.

By visiting the Website or voluntarily providing personal data, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Policy. This acknowledgement does not replace separate consent where applicable law requires Tai Ky Food to obtain it.

sections.title: Scope of this Policy
paragraphs: This Policy applies to personal data collected or processed through the Website, online forms, email, hotline, communications or promotional programmes, events, recruitment, customer care and related business interactions, unless a separate privacy notice or agreement applies.

Individuals covered may include consumers; customers and prospective customers; representatives of distributors, agents, retailers, suppliers and business partners; programme or event participants; subscribers; applicants; personnel; contractors; and Website visitors.
This Policy does not govern independent processing by third-party websites, platforms or services, even where the Website links to or embeds their content.

sections.title: Personal Data We May Collect
paragraphs: Identity and contact data: name, telephone number, email address, address, job title, organisation and other identifiers you voluntarily provide.

Transaction and business-relationship data: enquiry details, products of interest, communication history, quotations, orders, contracts, delivery, payment and information concerning the organisation you represent, where necessary for a transaction.

Customer-care and product-quality data: feedback, complaints, product images, place and time of purchase, lot or traceability information, circumstances of use and details necessary to receive, verify and resolve a request or comply with product-quality and food-safety obligations.

Programme and communications data: registration details, communication preferences, interaction content and information necessary to verify eligibility, contact participants and award prizes for lawfully conducted programmes.

Recruitment data: information in an application, curriculum vitae, cover letter, qualifications, certificates, experience, skills, career expectations, referee details and related supporting documents.
Technical and Website-use data: IP address, browser, operating system, device type, language, access time, pages viewed, referring source, cookies, online identifiers and similar technical data.

Tai Ky Food does not intentionally request sensitive personal data unless necessary. If you voluntarily provide sensitive data, or such processing is required—for example, health information relevant to a product-safety report—we will process it only on an appropriate legal basis, within the necessary scope and with suitable safeguards.

sections.title: How We Collect Personal Data
paragraphs: We may collect data directly when you complete a Website form, email us, call our hotline, communicate with customer care, subscribe to updates, enter a programme or event, submit an application, conduct a transaction or otherwise contact the Company.
Certain technical data may be collected automatically through cookies, server logs and similar technologies when you use the Website. Details are provided in our Cookie Policy.

We may also receive data from distributors, agents, retailers, business partners, service providers, competent authorities, lawful public sources or authorised third parties. The party providing data is responsible for ensuring that disclosure is lawful.

sections.title: Purposes of Processing
paragraphs: Tai Ky Food may process personal data for one or more of the following purposes:
receiving, verifying and responding to enquiries about products, recipes, points of sale, distribution, quotations, cooperation or support;
managing customer and business-partner relationships and preparing, entering into and performing orders, contracts or agreements;
handling feedback, complaints, returns, traceability requests, product-quality or food-safety matters, and carrying out warnings or recalls where legally required;
organising and administering promotions, surveys, events and consumer-engagement activities, including lawful prize fulfilment;
sending information about products, recipes, brands, programmes and events where we have a lawful basis;
operating, maintaining, securing and improving the Website; analysing traffic and user experience; and preventing fraud or unauthorised access;
assessing applications, communicating with candidates, arranging interviews, verifying information and maintaining recruitment records;

complying with legal obligations and competent-authority requests; maintaining records; auditing; managing risk; resolving disputes; and protecting the lawful rights and interests of Tai Ky Food or relevant parties; and
other purposes notified to you and supported by an appropriate legal basis.

sections.title: Legal Bases for Processing
paragraphs: Depending on the circumstances, Tai Ky Food processes personal data on one or more grounds permitted by law, including the data subject's consent; steps to enter into or perform a contract; compliance with legal obligations; circumstances in which processing without consent is permitted by law; and other lawful grounds.

Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw consent in accordance with applicable law. Withdrawal does not affect processing lawfully carried out before we receive the request and may affect our ability to provide particular content, programmes or support you requested.
We will provide required information and seek separate consent where mandated by law, especially for sensitive personal data or a materially different new purpose.

sections.title: Disclosure of Personal Data
paragraphs: Tai Ky Food does not sell personal data as a commodity. To the extent necessary for the purposes in this Policy, data may be disclosed to:
relevant departments, branches, factories or internal units of Tai Ky Food;
distributors, agents, retailers, logistics providers, delivery providers, customer-care providers or partners involved in resolving a request;
IT, hosting, cloud, Website analytics, communications, event, promotion, recruitment or operational service providers;
legal advisers, auditors, insurers, technical experts, laboratories or other professional advisers;
government authorities, courts, judicial bodies, law-enforcement agencies or other organisations where required or permitted by law; and
other organisations or individuals with valid consent or another appropriate legal basis.
We require recipients to process data only for authorised purposes, maintain confidentiality and implement safeguards appropriate to their role, scope of processing and applicable law.

sections.title: Cross-Border Transfers
paragraphs: In operating the Website and our business, Tai Ky Food may use technology platforms, storage systems or service providers whose servers or processing activities are located outside Vietnam.
Where personal data is transferred abroad, we will comply with the applicable requirements, conditions, documentation and safeguards under Vietnamese law.
Tai Ky Food applies reasonable measures so that data remains protected during transfer, storage and processing outside Vietnam.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: Tai Ky Food retains personal data for as long as necessary to fulfil the notified purposes, resolve your request, perform a contract or legal obligation, or protect the lawful rights and interests of relevant parties.

Retention periods may vary according to the type of data, including customer-care and product-traceability records, transaction and contract files, promotion data, recruitment records, technical data and dispute-resolution files.
When data is no longer required, we will delete, destroy, anonymise or restrict access in accordance with applicable law and internal procedures, unless continued retention is required.

sections.title: Information Security
paragraphs: Tai Ky Food implements reasonable technical, administrative and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, disclosure, alteration, misuse or destruction.

Measures may include access controls, account management, secure storage, backups, system logging, appropriate encryption, confidentiality requirements for personnel and service providers, and incident-response procedures.
No electronic transmission or storage method is completely secure. You should protect your devices and accounts and provide information only through official Tai Ky Food channels.

sections.title: Data Subject Rights
paragraphs: Depending on the circumstances and applicable law, you may have rights concerning your personal data, including the rights to be informed; give or withdraw consent; access; request provision, correction, updating, deletion or restriction; object to processing; complain, report violations or bring claims; and seek compensation as provided by law.

To exercise a right, contact us using the details at the end of this Policy. We may request reasonable information to verify your identity, clarify the request and protect the rights of relevant parties.

We will review and respond within the applicable period. In some circumstances, we may be unable to fulfil all or part of a request where continued processing or retention is required by law, contract, product-safety needs, dispute resolution or another lawful basis.

sections.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies
paragraphs: The Website may use cookies, server logs, pixels, local storage and similar technologies to support functionality, remember preferences, analyse performance, maintain security and improve user experience.
Our Cookie Policy describes cookie categories, purposes and preference controls. Disabling certain cookies may affect Website functionality or performance.

sections.title: Marketing Communications
paragraphs: Where we have a lawful basis, Tai Ky Food may use contact data to send information about products, recipes, brands, programmes, surveys, events or related content.
You may opt out of marketing communications at any time by using the unsubscribe instruction in a message or contacting the Company.
Opting out of marketing does not affect communications necessary for a transaction, customer care, product safety, a programme you entered or legal compliance.

sections.title: Recruitment Data
paragraphs: If you apply for a position, Tai Ky Food will process personal data to assess your application, communicate with you, arrange interviews, verify information where appropriate, administer recruitment and consider you for suitable future opportunities.
When providing information about a referee or another individual, you are responsible for ensuring that disclosure is lawful and that any required notice or consent has been obtained.
Applicant records are retained for a reasonable period consistent with recruitment purposes, consent and applicable law, unless you request otherwise or a retention obligation applies.

sections.title: Children's Data
paragraphs: The Website is not intended to request that children provide personal data without the involvement of a parent or guardian as required by law.

If children's data is collected in a particular programme or interaction, Tai Ky Food will provide an appropriate notice, conduct required verification and seek consent from the authorised person where legally required.
A parent or guardian may contact us to request review, correction or other handling of a child's data in accordance with applicable law.

sections.title: Third-Party Websites and Platforms
paragraphs: The Website may link to or embed third-party maps, videos, social media and other services. Those parties may process data under their own policies and operate independently from Tai Ky Food.
Tai Ky Food is not responsible for a third party's independent privacy practices. You should review the relevant policy before providing data to that third party.

sections.title: Changes to this Policy
paragraphs: Tai Ky Food may update this Policy to reflect changes in law, technology, Website functionality or business operations.

The updated version will be posted on the Website and will take effect from the date stated in that version. Where required by law, we will provide notice or obtain appropriate consent for changes that materially affect personal-data processing.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have questions, requests or complaints concerning this Policy or our processing of personal data, please contact:

When submitting a personal-data request, please provide enough information for us to verify your identity and understand the scope of your request. Tai Ky Food will receive, review and respond in accordance with applicable law.

cookie_en.title: COOKIE POLICY
intro: TAIKY FOOD - FLOUR JOINT STOCK COMPANY (“Tai Ky Food”, “the Company”, “we”, “our” or “us”) is committed to transparency regarding cookies and similar technologies used on our official website, including its webpages, forms, content and online features (collectively, the “Website”).
This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, why the Website may use them, the categories that may be used and how you can manage your choices. It should be read together with our Privacy Policy.

Strictly necessary cookies may be placed to operate and secure the Website to the extent permitted by law. For non-essential cookies, Tai Ky Food will record your preference or obtain consent where legally required and where cookie controls are implemented on the Website.

sections.title: What Are Cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small data files stored on your browser or device when you visit a website. They help a website recognise a browser or device, maintain a session, remember choices and improve functionality or performance.

Cookies do not usually identify an individual directly. However, if cookie data can identify a person or is combined with other information that identifies a person, it will be processed as personal data under our Privacy Policy and applicable law.

sections.title: Why We Use Cookies
paragraphs: The Website may use cookies and similar technologies to:
operate core functions, navigation and forms;
maintain security, prevent fraud and detect unusual activity;
remember language, region and display preferences;
measure traffic, performance and how users interact with content;
improve Website structure, content, recipes, product information and user experience; and
evaluate the effectiveness of online communications or programmes where we have a lawful basis.
Tai Ky Food does not use cookies to sell personal data. We do not intentionally collect sensitive personal data through cookies without an appropriate legal basis.

sections.title: Types of Cookies That May Be Used
paragraphs: Strictly necessary cookies: support core operations such as navigation, security, load balancing, session management and access to basic features. Disabling them may prevent the Website from functioning correctly.
Functional or preference cookies: remember language, region, display and other choices to provide a more convenient and consistent experience.

Performance and analytics cookies: collect statistical or aggregated information about visits, pages viewed, time spent, navigation paths, referring sources, browsers and devices to evaluate and improve the Website.

Communications or advertising cookies: may measure content and campaign effectiveness, limit display frequency or provide more relevant content, if actually implemented on the Website and where the necessary lawful basis or consent exists.
Security cookies: help detect fraud, prevent unauthorised access and protect the Website and users from information-security risks.

sections.title: Third-Party Cookies
paragraphs: The Website may integrate third-party services such as analytics tools, maps, videos, social media, recruitment platforms or embedded content. Those parties may place cookies or similar technologies on your device.

Third-party cookies are governed by the relevant provider's policies. Tai Ky Food does not independently control how those parties operate cookies, but we will select and manage providers within the scope of our responsibilities.
A specific list of tools or providers, if implemented, may be displayed in the Website's cookie preference panel or related notice.

sections.title: Cookie Duration
paragraphs: Session cookies: exist only during a browsing session and are generally deleted when you close your browser.
Persistent cookies: remain for a defined period or until you delete them. Duration depends on the purpose and configuration of each cookie.
Where a cookie-management tool is available, the specific duration of a cookie may be shown in the preference panel or cookie list on the Website.

sections.title: Managing Cookie Preferences
paragraphs: You may accept, reject or adjust non-essential cookies through the Website's cookie preference panel, if provided. You may also change your browser settings to block, restrict or delete cookies.

Rejecting non-essential cookies will generally not prevent access to basic content. However, blocking strictly necessary cookies or certain functional cookies may affect the operation, availability or experience of the Website.
Instructions for managing cookies are available in the help or privacy settings of your browser.

sections.title: Similar Technologies
paragraphs: In addition to cookies, the Website may use server logs, web beacons, pixels, device identifiers, local storage or other analytical tools to operate and secure the Website, measure performance and improve user experience.
If information collected through these technologies constitutes personal data, Tai Ky Food will process it in accordance with our Privacy Policy and applicable law.

sections.title: Protection of Personal Data
paragraphs: Personal data collected through cookies or similar technologies is processed in accordance with Law on Personal Data Protection No. 91/2025/QH15, Decree No. 356/2025/ND-CP and other relevant legal requirements.
Tai Ky Food implements reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect information against loss, unauthorised access, misuse, alteration or unlawful disclosure.

sections.title: Changes to this Cookie Policy
paragraphs: Tai Ky Food may update this Policy to reflect changes in law, technology, the cookies used, Website functionality or business operations.

The updated version will be published on the Website and will take effect from the date stated in that version. Where required by law, we will seek renewed consent or provide appropriate notice of a material change.
